title: Object came out of the water and zapped someone, per DoD intel contacts
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Object came out of the water and zapped someone, per DoD intel contacts, about c. 2024 at unspecified, water, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Just the other day, some people inside DoD Intel and I was told one of the things came out of the water medium and zapped hit somebody. Woo!
mean, I had a meeting just the other day, some people inside DoD Intel, and I was told, you know, one of the things came come out of the water and hit somebody.
tellings.difference: Says the object 'hit' somebody, without the word 'zapped'.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same 2024 account from DoD intelligence contacts of an object that came out of the water and hit someone.

as_told.title: Object came out of the water and hit someone, per DoD intelligence people

plain: Matthew Pines, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in late 2024 he met people working in intelligence at the Department of Defense, the US military's parent department. He says they told him that one of the unexplained objects rose out of the water and hit, or in one version zapped, a person. If true, it would mean these objects can come from the sea and harm people.
